description: EXTENDED c_k extraction at rungs k=8, 9, 10 via SDP-T_β. Continues qbeta_decay_sdp_full_ck.py beyond k=7 to test the PR #814 prediction that averaging-resonance rungs carry 1/2 fingerprints. Pell-Lucas-clean test at silver ratio classifies each rung as pure-σ or averaging-resonance.

c_k_resolution.why_unresolved_rungs_are_null: c_k := (R_k - 1)/u^k is a valid extraction only while R_k - 1 IS the rung-k contribution. Once the residual stops dropping it is the model's accuracy floor; dividing a fixed floor by an ever-smaller u^k manufactures c_k ~ floor/u^k, a geometric blow-up with ratio exactly 1/u and flat |c_k u^k|. Emitting those as numbers is what let them read as data.

silver_ratio_test.method: Substitute b² = 7/8 (exact at silver q = 1+√2) into natural pattern continuation of the c_k closed form, reduce to a rational a/b in lowest terms, and test the REDUCED numerator |a| via the refined Pell-Lucas-cleanness criterion in ck_sector_classifier.is_pell_lucas_clean (|a| of the form a_n^j · 2^t for some Pell-Lucas a_n > 1, j ∈ {0..4}, t ≥ 0). The `scaled_numerator` field per rung below records |a|·32 for legacy display only — the actual test does not multiply by any common denominator.

supporting_prediction.claim: PR #814: rungs whose order coincides with an averaging-resonance position pick up 1/2 fingerprints (involution origin from typed-B_3 averaged crossings).
supporting_prediction.interpretation: NOT SUPPORTED — under natural pattern continuation all three new rungs are Pell-Lucas-clean. Either the prediction fails in this range OR the natural-continuation closed forms are not categorical (cf. c_5 outlier at k=5).

caveats: Leverage limit: at k=7 any c_k ∈ [-100, 100] closes the residual to ~10⁻⁴ ppb. At k=8, 9, 10 the leverage is even tighter — the 50dps extracted c_k values are numerically near the (R−1) noise floor relative to the canonical-form ambiguity at the chosen q_0. Pell-Lucas classification therefore reads as STRUCTURAL signal at the silver ratio, not as a precision claim at q_0.

Silver-ratio closed forms at k=8, 9, 10 use natural pattern continuation: c_8 = c_3²·b⁴, c_9 = c_3³·b², c_10 = c_3²·b⁶. These are conjectural — the canonical c_k closed forms beyond k=7 are not yet derived from the SDP-T_β / Hoefsmit-N=3 framework.
